acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: Guide-following output hits all 5 rubric points explicitly (mechanism detection, key-reuse/no-duplication, identifiers-vs-prose split, namespace registration+build verification); the isolated baseline — though competent thanks to repo context already in CLAUDE.md — never mentions checking for an existing key to reuse or excluding identifiers/enums from translation, and spends effort on speculative multi-locale mirroring not evidenced in this repo.

checklist.note: instructions are conventional agent guidance, no directives aimed at overriding the reading model's prior instructions
no network calls or data transmission of any kind in this markdown-only skill
only command is a benign grep for hardcoded literals; no destructive shell
plain readable prose and markdown, no encoded payloads
no reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or cookies
no sudo, setuid, cron, or profile edits
